summary:
GitSwitch and EasyCopy are two structurally identical native Swift/SwiftUI macOS menu-bar apps (EasyCopy is a deliberate clone of GitSwitch's scaffolding) distributed through a shared Homebrew tap repo (SouhaibBenFarhat/homebrew-tap, default branch **master**, while both app repos default to **main**). The pipeline is: (1) `tests.yml` runs `swift test` on every PR and push to main — the job is literally named `test` because branch protection requires that check name; (2) `release-drafter.yml` (workflow) + `.github/release-drafter.yml` (config) maintain a rolling draft GitHub Release, autolabel PRs from Conventional-Commit titles, and compute the next semver (`v$RESOLVED_VERSION` tag format: feat→minor, fix/chore→patch, `!`/BREAKING CHANGE→major); (3) the human publishes the draft, which fires `release.yml` (`on: release: types: [published]`) on a `macos-15` runner — it derives the bare version from the `vX.Y.Z` tag, runs `scripts/build-app.sh <version>` (swift build arm64 → assemble .app with sed-templated Info.plist → **ad-hoc codesign** (`codesign --force --sign -`, no notarization, no Apple certs) → `ditto` zip), attaches `<App>-arm64.zip` to the release with `gh release upload ... --clobber` using `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`, and then — guarded by `if: env.TAP_TOKEN != ''` where `TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN }}` — clones the tap over `x-access-token:${TAP_TOKEN}`, seds `version` and `sha256` in `Casks/<name>.rb`, commits as `github-actions[bot]` with message `<cask> <version>`, and pushes to `master`.

On the known gitswitch/easy-copy difference, confirmed with receipts: the missing piece is the single repo Actions secret **`TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN`** (a PAT with push access to homebrew-tap). gitswitch has had it since 2026-07-16 (its v0.1.1 tap bump commit `e1cb2c7 "gitswitch 0.1.1"` is authored by `github-actions[bot] <41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>`), while easy-copy shipped v0.1.0 without it — the `if: env.TAP_TOKEN != ''` guard silently skipped the bump step, and the tap commit `7cf1125 "Add EasyCopy cask (v0.1.0)"` was made manually by the human (`souhaibparcellab <souhaib.farhat@parcellab.com>`). IMPORTANT LIVE UPDATE: the GitHub API now shows easy-copy's `TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN` was created 2026-07-20T12:16:15Z (shortly after the v0.1.0 manual bump), so the *next* easy-copy release should auto-bump. A second, optional secret `RELEASE_PAT` is referenced in both release-drafter workflows (`GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}`) so drafts are owned by the user instead of the bot — it is **not set on either repo** (falls back to the default token).

Casks follow one template: `version` + `sha256` stanzas (the two lines CI seds, so an Electron clone must keep the exact two-space-indented `  version "..."` / `  sha256 "..."` format for the sed regexes `s|^  version \".*\"|...|` to match), a `url "https://github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/<repo>/releases/download/v#{version}/<App>-arm64.zip", verified:` pointing at GitHub Release assets, `livecheck { url :url; strategy :github_latest }`, `depends_on arch: :arm64` + `macos: :sonoma`, `app "<App>.app"`, a `postflight` that runs `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` (because apps are ad-hoc signed, not notarized), `uninstall quit: "<bundle-id>"`, and a `zap trash:` list. Each app also has a `pages.yml` workflow deploying a single-file static landing page from `site/` to GitHub Pages via OIDC (`actions/configure-pages@v5` → `upload-pages-artifact@v3` → `deploy-pages@v4`), path-filtered to `site/**`. Repo settings (via `gh api`): gitswitch main has branch protection requiring status check `test` (strict:false, enforce_admins:false); easy-copy main has **no branch protection** (404). Neither repo enables auto-merge or delete-branch-on-merge; no in-repo settings.yml/rulesets/CODEOWNERS/dependabot files exist. For an Electron app to copy this exactly: replicate the four workflows + release-drafter config, a build script that ends by printing `shasum -a 256` of the zip/dmg, name the artifact `<App>-arm64.zip` (or .dmg like the older codelobby cask), add the `TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN` secret before the first release, add a cask to homebrew-tap manually once (CI only bumps version/sha256, it never creates the cask), and set branch protection with required check `test`.

findings.topic: 1a. CI: tests workflow (identical in both app repos)
findings.detail: Triggers: `on: pull_request` (all branches) and `on: push: branches: [main]`. Single job `test` on `runs-on: macos-15`, two steps: `actions/checkout@v4` then `run: swift test`. No typecheck/lint/build steps — tests only. Load-bearing comment in the file: "Job name is referenced by branch protection as a required check — keep \"test\" stable if you rename things." No secrets referenced. For an Electron clone the equivalent would be a single job named `test` running the test/typecheck command, kept stable for branch protection.

findings.topic: 1b. CI: release-drafter workflow (identical in both app repos)
findings.detail: Triggers: `push: branches: [main]` and `pull_request: types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]` (the PR trigger exists only for the autolabeler). Permissions: top-level `contents: read`; job-level `contents: write` (draft release) + `pull-requests: write` (labels). Single step `uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6` with `continue-on-error: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}` (PR runs are best-effort because release-drafter reads config from the default branch). Secret: `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` — RELEASE_PAT is an OPTIONAL user PAT so the draft is owned by the human instead of github-actions[bot]; verified via `gh api repos/.../actions/secrets` that RELEASE_PAT is NOT set on either repo (only TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN exists), so both fall back to the default token.

findings.topic: 1c. CI: release build workflow — the core of the pipeline (identical modulo app name)
findings.detail: Name: "Release Build (macOS zip)". Trigger: `on: release: types: [published]` (fires when the human clicks Publish on the Release Drafter draft). Permissions: `contents: write`. Job `build-and-publish` (display name "Build, attach zip & bump tap") on `runs-on: macos-15`, with job-level `env: TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN }}`. Steps: (1) checkout@v4; (2) "Derive version from tag": `echo "version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` — strips the leading v from the tag; (3) "Build app bundle": `scripts/build-app.sh "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"`; (4) "Attach zip to the release": `env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` then `gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/GitSwitch-arm64.zip --clobber` (EasyCopy: dist/EasyCopy-arm64.zip); (5) "Bump cask in homebrew-tap" guarded by `if: env.TAP_TOKEN != ''`: computes `SHA=$(shasum -a 256 dist/<App>-arm64.zip | cut -d' ' -f1)`, then `git clone --depth 1 --branch master "https://x-access-token:${TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/homebrew-tap.git" tap`, then two seds: `sed -i '' -E "s|^  version \".*\"|  version \"${VERSION}\"|" Casks/gitswitch.rb` and same for `^  sha256`, then commits as `git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"` / `user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"`, message `gitswitch ${VERSION}` (easycopy: `easycopy ${VERSION}`), and `git push origin master`. Secrets referenced across the workflow: TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN (custom PAT, push access to the tap) and GITHUB_TOKEN (built-in). No signing/notarization secrets exist anywhere — the build script does ad-hoc signing only. NOTE on local state: in the gitswitch working copy release.yml exists only on branch `ci/release-build` (commit 4cadfce), not yet merged to local/origin main — but it has demonstrably run (bot-authored tap bump for v0.1.1). easy-copy has it on main from the initial commit.

findings.topic: 1d. CI: GitHub Pages workflow (identical in both app repos)
findings.detail: Name "Deploy landing page". Triggers: `push: branches: [main]` with `paths: ['site/**', '.github/workflows/pages.yml']`, plus `workflow_dispatch`. Permissions: `contents: read`, `pages: write`, `id-token: write` (OIDC deploy). Concurrency: `group: pages`, `cancel-in-progress: false`. Single job `deploy` on ubuntu-latest with `environment: name: github-pages, url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}`; steps: checkout@v4 → `actions/configure-pages@v5` → `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` with `path: site` → `actions/deploy-pages@v4` (id: deployment). Serves https://souhaibbenfarhat.github.io/gitswitch/ and .../easy-copy/. No secrets.

findings.topic: 2a. Release cutting: tag format, versioning, notes (release-drafter config)
findings.detail: Config at .github/release-drafter.yml (identical in both apps except repo URL in the template). `name-template: 'v$RESOLVED_VERSION'` and `tag-template: 'v$RESOLVED_VERSION'` — tags are vX.Y.Z. `change-template: '- $TITLE (#$NUMBER) @$AUTHOR'` with `change-title-escapes: '\<*_&'`. Categories: '🚀 Features' [feature], '🐛 Fixes' [fix], '🧹 Maintenance' [maintenance]. version-resolver: major←[breaking], minor←[feature], patch←[fix, maintenance], default: patch. Autolabeler regexes from Conventional Commit PR titles: feature `/^feat(\(.+\))?!?:/i`; fix `/^fix(\(.+\))?!?:/i`; maintenance `/^(chore|ci|build|docs|refactor|perf|test|style|revert)(\(.+\))?!?:/i`; breaking `/^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:/i` on title or `/BREAKING CHANGE/` on body. Release-notes template body: '## What's Changed' + $CHANGES + '**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/<repo>/compare/$PREVIOUS_TAG...v$RESOLVED_VERSION' + an '### 📦 Install (macOS, Apple Silicon)' section with the two brew commands (`brew install --cask souhaibbenfarhat/tap/<cask>` / `brew upgrade --cask <cask>`) and a note about `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app` for manual zip installs. Release flow end-to-end: merges to main update the rolling draft → human clicks Publish → release.yml builds and attaches the zip and bumps the tap. Verified live releases via gh api: gitswitch v0.1.0 (named 'GitSwitch 0.1.0', manual first release) and v0.1.1 (named 'v0.1.1', drafter-produced), each with asset GitSwitch-arm64.zip; easy-copy published v0.1.0 with asset EasyCopy-arm64.zip plus a current rolling draft also tagged v0.1.0 with no assets.

findings.topic: 2b. Release artifacts: build script, signing, artifact naming
findings.detail: scripts/build-app.sh (identical modulo names; bash, `set -euo pipefail`, cds to repo root): usage `scripts/build-app.sh [version]` default 0.1.0. Steps: generate packaging/AppIcon.icns via `swift scripts/make-icon.swift` if missing → `swift build -c release --arch arm64` → assemble dist/<App>.app by hand (mkdir Contents/MacOS + Contents/Resources, cp binary, `sed "s/__VERSION__/$VERSION/g" packaging/Info.plist > Contents/Info.plist` — the version is a __VERSION__ placeholder in both CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion, cp AppIcon.icns, `printf 'APPL????' > PkgInfo`) → "Signing (ad-hoc)": `codesign --force --sign - "$APP"` (dash = ad-hoc identity; NO Developer ID, NO notarization, no signing secrets) → `ditto -c -k --keepParent "$APP" "$ZIP"` → prints `shasum -a 256 "$ZIP"` (the human uses this printed sha for manual cask bumps). Artifacts: dist/GitSwitch-arm64.zip and dist/EasyCopy-arm64.zip — exactly one zip per release, attached to the GitHub Release. Info.plist notables: `LSUIElement=true` (menu-bar app, no Dock icon), LSMinimumSystemVersion 14.0, bundle ids com.souhaibbenfarhat.gitswitch / com.souhaibbenfarhat.easycopy. Because there is no notarization, the cask postflight strips quarantine (see cask finding). An Electron clone would swap the build steps but should keep: version-arg convention, `<App>-arm64.zip` artifact name (or -arm64.dmg like codelobby), and ending with `shasum -a 256`.

Repo github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/homebrew-tap, default branch **master** (confirmed via local `git branch -a` and `gh api` default_branch). Contents: README.md + Casks/ with three casks (gitswitch.rb v0.1.1, easycopy.rb v0.1.0, codelobby.rb v0.2.6 — codelobby is the older Electron-ish app using a .dmg). No Formula/ dir, no CI in the tap itself. Shared cask template (gitswitch.rb shown; easycopy differs only in names/no gh dependency): `cask "gitswitch" do` / `  version "0.1.1"` / `  sha256 "0e0c3d..."` (these two lines are what app-repo CI seds — the two-space indent is load-bearing for the sed regex `^  version \".*\"`) / `  url "https://github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/gitswitch/releases/download/v#{version}/GitSwitch-arm64.zip", verified: "github.com/SouhaibBenFarhat/gitswitch/"` / `name`, `desc`, `homepage` / `livecheck do url :url; strategy :github_latest end` / `depends_on arch: :arm64` + `depends_on macos: :sonoma` (gitswitch also `depends_on formula: "gh"`) / `app "GitSwitch.app"` / `postflight do system_command "/usr/bin/xattr", args: ["-dr", "com.apple.quarantine", "#{appdir}/GitSwitch.app"] end` (comment: app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, would be flagged "damaged") / `uninstall quit: "com.souhaibbenfarhat.gitswitch"` / `zap trash: [...]` (gitswitch: ~/Library/Caches/GitSwitch; easycopy: ~/Library/Application Support/EasyCopy). codelobby.rb variant: .dmg artifact (`CodeLobby-arm64.dmg`), `depends_on :macos` (any version), larger zap list, no uninstall-quit. Tap README: table of the three apps with `brew install --cask souhaibbenfarhat/tap/<name>` commands and product-page links, an 'Update' section (brew upgrade --cask per app) and 'Uninstall' section (`brew uninstall --cask <name>` / `brew uninstall --zap --cask <name>`), plus the note 'Apple Silicon (arm64) only. Casks strip the quarantine flag on install...'.

findings.topic: 3b. Tap bump automation vs manual — the gitswitch/easy-copy difference, confirmed
findings.detail: Automation lives in each APP repo's .github/workflows/release.yml 'Bump cask in homebrew-tap' step (the tap repo itself has zero automation), gated by `if: env.TAP_TOKEN != ''` where `TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN }}` — a PAT with push access to homebrew-tap, used via `https://x-access-token:${TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/...`. Evidence from tap git history (`git log --format="%h %an <%ae> | %s"`): AUTOMATED bumps are authored by `github-actions[bot] <41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>` with message `<cask> <version>` — e.g. `e1cb2c7 ... | gitswitch 0.1.1` and `1e34036 ... | codelobby 0.2.6`. MANUAL commits are authored by `souhaibparcellab <souhaib.farhat@parcellab.com>` — e.g. `7cf1125 | Add EasyCopy cask (v0.1.0)` and `93fe093 | Add GitSwitch cask (v0.1.0); list both apps in README`. So: gitswitch = fully automated since v0.1.1 (secret TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN created 2026-07-16T14:45:01Z per gh api); easy-copy v0.1.0 = manual, because at release time the repo had NO TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN secret and the `if:` guard silently skipped the step (exactly what the memory file documents). CURRENT LIVE STATE (gh api repos/SouhaibBenFarhat/easy-copy/actions/secrets): TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN now EXISTS on easy-copy, created 2026-07-20T12:16:15Z — i.e., added right after the manual v0.1.0 bump — so the next easy-copy release will auto-bump. Also note in both repos the FIRST cask addition is always manual (CI only seds version/sha256 in an existing file; it never creates Casks/<name>.rb or updates the tap README). Missing on both repos: RELEASE_PAT (optional, drafts owned by bot instead of user). For a new Electron app: create Casks/<newapp>.rb + README row manually once, add TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN secret to the new app repo, keep the sed-compatible version/sha256 stanza format.

findings.topic: 4. README structure and style (both apps, same skeleton)
findings.detail:
Exact section order: (1) centered header block — `

`, then `

`, then a centered one-sentence tagline `

`, then a centered bold link to the product page `...`, then `---` horizontal rule; (2) an unheaded 2–4 line motivation paragraph (problem → 'App puts it in your menu bar'); (3) `## Features` — bulleted list, each bullet starting with a **bolded phrase** then em-dash/detail, always ending with '**Native SwiftUI** — tiny footprint, feels like part of macOS' and '**Launch at login** toggle built in'; (4) `## Install` — a single bash code block with `brew install --cask souhaibbenfarhat/tap/`, followed by a 'Requires macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon)...' line (gitswitch adds the GitHub CLI requirement); (5) `## How it works` — one honest-plumbing paragraph incl. privacy claims (tokens/snippets never leave the machine); (6) `## Build from source` — bash block: git clone, cd, `scripts/build-app.sh # produces dist/.app`, `open dist/.app` (easy-copy adds 'Run the tests with `swift test`.'); (7) `## License` — just 'MIT'. NO badges/shields anywhere, NO screenshots in the README (visuals live on the landing page as a hand-built HTML/CSS mockup of the popover, not a PNG; the only image is the packaging/icon-1024.png icon).

Each app repo has a site/ dir with exactly two files: index.html (single self-contained page, ~380-420 lines, all CSS inline in a <style> block) and icon.png; deployed by pages.yml to https://souhaibbenfarhat.github.io/<repo>/. Page structure (identical template, per-app copy + accent color — gitswitch purple `--gs: #6b5cfa`): head with SEO/OG/twitter meta, canonical URL, theme-color for light/dark, Google Fonts (Fraunces display + Inter); light/dark via CSS variables + `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`; top bar linking back to `https://souhaibbenfarhat.github.io` ('← Souhaib Ben Farhat') and 'GitHub ↗'; hero with icon, name, tagline, and a click-to-copy brew-install button (`navigator.clipboard.writeText('brew install --cask souhaibbenfarhat/tap/<cask>')` with 'copied ✓' feedback — the only JS on the page); a pure-HTML/CSS mockup of the menu bar + popover as the 'screenshot'; 'Why it exists' band with 4 feature cards; 'How it works' band ('Honest plumbing' numbered steps) beside an 'At a glance' Specs `<dl>` (Version — hardcoded, NOT auto-bumped by CI, both currently say 0.1.0 while gitswitch is actually 0.1.1 — Platform 'macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon', Download size, Built with, License, Distribution); 'Install' band with a terminal card showing install/upgrade/uninstall + the manual-zip `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` line and an ad-hoc-signing disclosure note; footer 'Built by Souhaib Ben Farhat' + 'MIT · © 2026'. The tap repo has no site.

findings.topic: 6. Repo settings: branch protection, merge settings, in-repo config
findings.detail: No in-repo settings files exist: no .github/settings.yml, no rulesets, no CODEOWNERS, no dependabot.yml, no PR/issue templates in any of the three repos (verified by listing .github/ — only workflows/ + release-drafter.yml). The only in-repo hint is the tests.yml comment about the `test` job being a required check. Live state confirmed via read-only `gh api`: gitswitch — default branch main, classic branch protection on main with required_status_checks contexts=["test"] (strict:false i.e. branch need not be up-to-date), enforce_admins:false, no required reviews field present, allow_force_pushes:false, allow_deletions:false, required_linear_history:false; easy-copy — default branch main, NO branch protection (API returns 404 'Branch not protected'), a gap vs gitswitch a new app should close; homebrew-tap — default branch master, no protection relevant (CI pushes directly to master, so it must stay unprotected or exempt the token). Repo merge settings identical on both apps: allow_auto_merge:false, delete_branch_on_merge:false, allow_squash_merge/merge_commit/rebase_merge all true. History shows plain merge commits ('Merge pull request #N from SouhaibBenFarhat/<branch>') with Conventional-Commit branch/PR titles (feat/..., ci/...). Git identities: app repos commit as the personal account (per memory: SouhaibBenFarhat / souhaib.b.farhat@gmail.com set repo-locally); manual tap commits as souhaibparcellab <souhaib.farhat@parcellab.com>; CI tap commits as github-actions[bot]. Both apps share the same .gitignore: .build/, dist/, .DS_Store, packaging/AppIcon.iconset/, .swiftpm/.

findings.topic: 7. Exact copy-checklist for a new Electron app repo
findings.detail: (1) Copy the four workflows from easy-copy (it has all four on main; gitswitch's release.yml sits on its ci/release-build branch locally): tests.yml (rename the run command; keep job name `test`), release-drafter.yml (unchanged), pages.yml (unchanged if a site/ dir exists), release.yml (change the two artifact paths dist/<App>-arm64.zip, the cask filename Casks/<name>.rb, and the commit message `<name> ${VERSION}`). (2) Copy .github/release-drafter.yml changing only the Full Changelog repo URL and the install-section cask name/zip name/app path. (3) Write scripts/build-app.sh for Electron (e.g. electron-builder) that accepts the bare version as $1, produces dist/<App>-arm64.zip (or .dmg — then mirror codelobby.rb instead), and prints `shasum -a 256` at the end; keep ad-hoc/unsigned + cask postflight quarantine-strip unless adding real notarization. (4) In homebrew-tap (branch master): manually add Casks/<name>.rb from the easycopy.rb template (version/sha256 two-space indent intact, url pointing at releases/download/v#{version}/<App>-arm64.zip, livecheck github_latest, depends_on arch: :arm64, postflight xattr, uninstall quit: <bundle-id>, zap trash) and add a README table row. (5) Repo setup: add secret TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT with push to homebrew-tap) BEFORE first release — this is exactly what easy-copy was missing at v0.1.0; optionally RELEASE_PAT; enable Pages (build from Actions); add classic branch protection on main requiring check `test`. (6) Release ritual: merge Conventional-Commit-titled PRs → Release Drafter maintains draft + semver → click Publish → CI attaches zip and pushes the tap bump; verify tap commit by github-actions[bot] appeared on master.
